title: OpenSCAD build-and-measure grader and tasks
acceptance: Candidate OpenSCAD source is rendered inside the coding runner's sandbox; the grader measures bounding box and volume from the STL
Pass when every measured dimension is within the case tolerance; fixtures that build right, build wrong and fail to build
Regression and holdout splits; index entry
privacy: Neutral invented cases and fixtures only; no consumer data, private reports or credentials in Git.
validation: Failing pack test first; fixture for each acceptance item; npm test; npm run check:index; CI
escalation: No knowledge of any consumer; a consumer-specific need goes to that consumer's backlog
Material scope or effort growth goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Merged in PR #103 on green CI on 2026-11-25 (CI uses OpenSCAD stand-ins, owner decision). Real render 2026-11-25 on the owner's Mac (Docker 29.8.0, arm64, no model call): the pinned digest sha256:147e4852... resolves on Docker Hub (multi-arch list with linux/arm64 and linux/amd64) and pulls; through gradeOpenScad with containerExecutor, all four reference.scad fixtures pass (spacer 12/12/15 mm, 1270.30 mm3; L-bracket 40/25/30, 8125; tray 50/30/20, 8472; bushing 24/24/16, 2709.98), every wrong.scad fails dimension-mismatch and every broken.scad fails build-error, about 0.3 s per render. Known limitation: only bounding box and volume are measured, so a wrong shape with the right extents and volume passes (an L-bracket with its wall at X = 35 instead of X = 0 measured 40/25/30, 8125, passed). No actual: elapsed time not measured across sessions.
